newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank sets tender for 14-day repos at 3.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank sets tender for 14-day repos at 3.0 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Tuesday it was setting a tender for 14-day securities repurchase funds, offering banks liquidity at a fixed three percent rate.
Funds will be credited to accounts tomorrow, Wednesday, and the securities have to be repurchased on September 25.
A 65.0 billion mark facility set at a fixed 3.00 percent rate expires on Wednesday.
A 14-day facility set last week also carried a fixed interest rate of three percent.
